content.text: I've reviewed the term/termination, fees, and remedies provisions. No liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination fee payable by AP exists anywhere in the agreement.

input.quote: Except for termination for material breach as detailed in paragraph 4(b), Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period regardless of which Party terminates the Agreement
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum-fee obligation payable by AP, which matches the preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages). Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "minimum", and termination/fee language return nothing of that kind. The only termination-payment language (paragraph 4(a)) entitles Kubient to "all fees generated during the termination period" — under the revenue-share model in paragraph 5 these are amounts generated from Advertisers and paid by Kubient to AP, not a sum AP pays out, so it is not a Customer-payable liquidated amount. Paragraph 5 likewise imposes no fixed fees on AP, and paragraph 62 confirms no minimum revenue guarantee runs against either Party. Note for context that fee terms sit in Exhibits not included here; if any Exhibit adds an early-termination or shortfall payment by AP, it should be capped at three months' fees per the fallback. No redline required.
